claims.content: Successfully suspend or deactivate a customer account

goal.raw_text: Successfully suspend or deactivate a customer account

claims.content: Customer Service Representative
The Customer Service Representative has access to the Customer History Page.
A supervisor’s authorization code is available for account deactivation (if deactivating).
A Customer Service Representative clicks the Deactivate or Suspend button on a customer account in the Results section of the Customer History Page.

trigger.raw_text: A Customer Service Representative clicks the Deactivate or Suspend button on a customer account in the Results section of the Customer History Page.

claims.content: The Customer Service Representative initiates the suspension or deactivation of a customer account from the Customer History Page.
If deactivating the account, a pop-up DIV layer appears asking for a supervisor’s authorization code.
The Customer Service Representative inputs the supervisor’s authorization code (issued by Administrators and generated by the Auction Admin application).
Upon successful authorization, the system suspends or deactivates the customer account.
If the account is deactivated, it is listed in RED on the Customer History Page.
If the supervisor’s authorization code is invalid or not provided, the system does not proceed with deactivation and exits the use case without changing account status.

If the email address being used to create a new account exists on an email blacklist, the system prevents account creation — though this is not directly part of suspension/deactivation flow, it implies system-enforced constraints that may block related actions if misconfigured.
The customer account is suspended or deactivated, and if deactivated, it is listed in RED on the Customer History Page.
If the account was suspended, the customer’s bidding rights are permanently suspended (“Deactivate an Account”).
A Customer Care manager has approved the suspension via code, as required for permanent suspension of bidding rights.
The system enforces that no new account can be created using an email address that exists on an email blacklist (if applicable to reactivation or related flows).
